summary: FM-001 Creative Studio graceful-degradation fix verified end-to-end. Backend endpoint POST /api/products/{pid}/creative-brief now returns HTTP 200 with a deterministic fallback brief while the OpenAI daily spend limit is active. All 5 backend tests pass; the frontend Product Detail page renders the full brief and no longer shows 'Enhancement failed'.
critical_code_review_comments: products.py: exception mapping in creative_brief uses substring checks ('spend limit', 'quota', 'budget', '503') on stringified exception. Robust enough for current LLM error surfaces but a structured error type (e.g. LLMQuotaExceeded) would be cleaner and less fragile.

The stage note is surfaced via toast.warning which auto-dismisses in a few seconds. Consider also rendering a persistent inline chip on the ProductDetail page (e.g. next to the Creative Studio badge) so operators can see WHY the brief is deterministic after the toast disappears — currently the only surface is the transient toast.
products.py is 353 lines — still under the 700-line threshold but growing; assemble/generate/creative-brief could each move to their own submodule as it expands.

context_for_next_testing_agent: FM-001 fix is verified. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_fm001_creative_brief.py covers 5 scenarios: list regression, detail regression, 200 with deterministic fallback + AI Brief Writer stage note + Reviewed status, persistence via GET, and 404 on unknown pid. All pass. Frontend UI on /products/{id} shows the deterministic brief block after clicking [data-testid='pd-creative-btn'] with no 'Enhancement failed' toast. The toast.warning with stage note fires briefly then auto-dismisses (sonner default); DOM body no longer contains 'Enhancement failed'.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: POST /api/products/{pid}/creative-brief unconditionally called ai_service.llm_generate() which raises HTTPException/exception when OpenAI daily spend limit is exceeded. The exception bubbled up as a 500/503 which the frontend collapsed into a generic 'Enhancement failed' toast because no error detail was surfaced.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_verified: products.py wraps llm_generate in try/except. On failure it builds _fallback_brief(p) deterministically from product fields, sets brief_source='deterministic', and constructs a stage-specific note ('AI Brief Writer™: provider quota exceeded — used a deterministic on-brand brief.'). Endpoint persists creative_brief, creative_brief_source, related_products, creative_status='Reviewed', then returns the product with enhancement_stage_note + enhancement_source. Frontend (ProductDetail.js & CreativeStudio.js) reads enhancement_stage_note and shows it via toast.warning instead of 'Enhancement failed'.
verification_steps: curl POST /api/products/{valid_pid}/creative-brief -> 200, enhancement_source='deterministic', enhancement_stage_note contains 'AI Brief Writer', creative_status='Reviewed', creative_brief has all 8 keys populated.
POST on unknown pid -> 404 {detail: 'Product not found'}.

UI login as Founder -> Product Library -> open product -> click [data-testid='pd-creative-btn'] -> [data-testid='pd-creative-brief'] block renders with who_for/problem_solved/skills_gained/etc.; 'Enhancement failed' never appears.
